parameters.query: ={{ (() => { const body = $json.body || {}; const q = value => "'" + String(value || '').replace(/'/g, "''") + "'"; const action = body.action; if (action === 'list') return 'SELECT id, username, email, created_at FROM profiles ORDER BY LOWER(username)'; if (action === 'create') return `INSERT INTO profiles (username, email, password_hash) VALUES (${q(body.username)}, ${q(body.email)}, crypt(${q(body.password)}, gen_salt('bf', 12))) RETURNING id, username, email, created_at`; if (action === 'login') return `SELECT id, username, email, created_at FROM profiles WHERE username = ${q(body.username)} AND password_hash = crypt(${q(body.password)}, password_hash)`; throw new Error('Unsupported profile action'); })() }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ (() => { const body = $('Profile Auth Webhook').item.json.body || {}; const rows = $input.all().map(item => item.json); if (body.action === 'list') return { status: 'success', profiles: rows }; if (rows.length === 0) return { status: 'error', message: 'Incorrect username or password' }; return { status: 'success', profile: rows[0] }; })() }}
